scripts.dev: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @modernizer/contracts build && pnpm --filter @modernizer/web dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @modernizer/contracts build && pnpm --filter @modernizer/api dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @modernizer/contracts build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @modernizer/contracts build && vitest run
